scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @ridewave/api" "npm run dev -w @ridewave/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ridewave/api && npm run build -w @ridewave/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @ridewave/api && npm run lint -w @ridewave/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ridewave/api && npm run typecheck -w @ridewave/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ridewave/api && npm run test -w @ridewave/web
